label: AB_hP4_194_c_a-001
title: Nickeline (NiAs, $B8_{1}$) Structure
comments:
Note that the stacking is ABACABAC, with the nickel atoms on the A sites and arsenic on B and C. The local environment is fcc-like for nickel atoms and hcp-like for arsenic atoms. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/AB_hP4_194_c_a-001}{NiAs $B8_{1}$} and \href{current_web_home_dir/AB_hP4_194_c_a-003}{Fe$_{2}$N $L'3_{0}$} share the same AFLOW prototype label, AB\_hP4\_194\_c\_a. The structures are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files.
